Title: ExpressRoute Global Reach is now available

Body.Content:
Connect your on-premises networks via the ExpressRoute service through the Microsoft global network by using Azure ExpressRoute Global Reach. For example, if you have a private data center in California connected to ExpressRoute in Silicon Valley, and another private data center in Texas connected to ExpressRoute in Dallas, with ExpressRoute Global Reach, they can connect their private data centers together through the two ExpressRoute connections and their cross data center traffic will traverse through the Microsoft network backbone.
